description: The brilliant "match 3" puzzle game for everybody who loves a magic atmosphere, ancient mysteries and a crystal chime of jewels. Immerse yourself into a fascinating journey through deserts, oases of Ancient Egypt, jungle, pirate seas and dungeons!
